description: Returns a paginated list of all affliction types configured for the specified company.

parameters.name: filters[active]
parameters.description: If true, returns item(s) with a status of 'active'.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field.

id.description: Unique identifier for this affliction type.

name.description: Display name of the affliction type, localized to the requester's language preference.

name_key.description: Untranslated key for the affliction type name. Use this value for programmatic comparisons rather than the localized name field.

active.description: Indicates whether this affliction type is available for selection when recording injuries. Inactive types are hidden from end users.

global.description: Indicates whether this affliction type is a Procore-provided default. Global types cannot have their names changed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this affliction type was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to this affliction type.
